title: 宝塚記念の後に・焦り禁物わかってらあ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One wins the Takarazuka Kinen and is finally seen by the audience as someone with equal prowess to Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she seems dissatisfied by her performance today. Even after the race ends, she remains stiff and uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set autumn Tenno Sho as our next big goal. It's almost certain that both Oguri Cap and Super Creek will be racing in it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time to embark on our path with a fresh start, so as a warm-up leading to the autumn Tenno Sho, we also decide to take on the Mainichi Okan.
